**.inp: A measured rule, new on this site: it reports without failing while its findings are fixed and its budget settles on CI's runners.
**.layout-shift: A measured rule, new on this site: it reports without failing while its findings are fixed and its budget settles on CI's runners.
**.first-content: A measured rule, new on this site: it reports without failing while its findings are fixed and its budget settles on CI's runners.
**.off-scale: A rule new on this site: its hand-tuned rem spacing reports without failing while it moves to Tailwind's spacing steps.

/docs/message/.nested-frame: The squircle radii are 1.5 times larger, so the message demo's quote block, a small block inside a large bubble, nests at 23px by the rule; its radius stays small and the quote bar is a 4px pill.

off-theme: .stage-window sets box-shadow: oklab(0 none none / 0.35) 0px 10px 14px -12px, a fixed shadow
[data-theme="pearl"] .stage-crew sets box-shadow: oklab(1 0 5.96046e-8 / 0.55) 0px 1px inset, a fixed shadow
[data-theme="pearl"] .stage-frame sets box-shadow: oklab(1 0 5.96046e-8 / 0.5) 0px 1px inset, a fixed shadow
[data-theme="pearl"].dark .stage-console, .dark[data-theme="pearl"] .stage-console sets box-shadow: oklab(0 none none / 0.6) 0px 28px 56px -28px, a fixed shadow
[data-theme="pearl"].dark .stage-crew, .dark[data-theme="pearl"] .stage-crew sets box-shadow: oklab(1 0 5.96046e-8 / 0.08) 0px 1px inset, a fixed shadow
